nameEn: Retail sale of games and toys in specialised stores
description: This class includes the retail sale of games and toys in specialised stores.
includes: retail sale of toys of all kinds: dolls, toy cars, construction sets
retail sale of board games and card games
retail sale of video games: consoles, controllers, game software
retail sale of hobbies: model kits, puzzles, craft supplies
excludes: retail sale of sporting equipment, see 4763
